entities.summary: Nataliya Nikolayevna Razumova is a retired Russian volleyball player who competed for the now defunct Soviet Union. Born in Revda, Sverdlovsk Oblast, she competed for the Soviet national team at the 1980 Moscow Olympics, where she won a gold medal.
